latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of neckr0ik-socialposter — a multi-platform social media automation tool.

- Schedule and publish posts across Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, and Bluesky.
- Plan content calendar weeks or months ahead.
- Set up automatic replies triggered by keywords.
- Track engagement and account growth analytics.
- Recommend optimal posting times for each platform.
- Command-line tool with configuration for API credentials and timezone.
